facts: Docs https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks: SubagentStop fires on sub-agent finish only; input adds agent_id, agent_type, agent_transcript_path, stop_hook_active, last_assistant_message
Same docs: exit 2 + stderr reason prevents the sub-agent stopping (it continues); matcher filters agent type; main/claude -p sessions fire Stop, so chat+runner judgement are exempt
Refuse rule guard_agent_exit.py:run_state: last BGRUN START of an attributed log has no END/TIMEOUT/KILLED and BGRUN PID alive (OpenProcess+STILL_ACTIVE, image py*)
Attribution 1 guard_agent_exit.py:logs_from_transcript: --log of bgrun calls in the agent's own transcript; START older than the call-300s is ignored (reused log)
Attribution 2 guard_agent_exit.py:logs_from_ledger: launches.jsonl rows of the card bound to agent_id in active.json, not older than the bind
Fail-open on any exception (FAIL-OPEN logged); dead PID w/o END allowed (DEAD-NO-END); 4th stop per (agent,log) allowed (LOOP-BREAKER); log tools/bench/guard_agent_exit.log, state %TEMP%
